versions.name: RXV2-0.9.702-dongle-channels
versions.notes: View channels now works on a dongle. A dongle has no radio of its own, so it asks the flight controller what its receiver is giving it and shows those - the bars and the little helicopter prove the whole chain, from your transmitter through its receiver to the flight controller. It pauses while the model is armed. Includes 0.9.701.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.701-gear-joined
versions.notes: On the 3D helicopter the landing-gear supports now actually join up: they reach the skids below and go up into the frame above, instead of stopping just short of both. Includes 0.9.700.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.700-wire-loops
versions.notes: The stray wires on the 3D helicopter are loops now: they come out of the frame a little way and go back in, instead of stopping in mid-air with a cut end. Includes 0.9.699.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.699-stray-wires
versions.notes: A few stray wires now peek out of the back of the 3D helicopter's frame, the way nobody's loom is ever quite tucked in. Three leads, each with its own droop and deliberately not matching. Includes 0.9.698.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.698-tail-clearance
versions.notes: On the 3D helicopter the tail skid now reaches further down, and the tail rotor is larger - its lowest point comes to just above the bottom of the skid, so the skid would touch first. Includes 0.9.697.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.697-tail-tidy
versions.notes: Three tidies to the 3D helicopter: the horizontal stabiliser at the back has gone, the tail rotor is a bit bigger, and two black posts that had been poking out of the belly have gone. Those posts were a mistake - a cross-tube that was never turned on its side, so it stood on its end. Includes 0.9.696.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.696-tail-line
versions.notes: The 3D helicopter has lost the orange fin that stuck up from its tail, and the tail rotor now turns on the tail boom's own centreline instead of floating above it. The gearbox and tail skid moved down to match. Includes 0.9.695.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.695-ldrc-livery
versions.notes: The 3D helicopter now carries our own name. The shell reads LDRC over LOCKDOWN RADIO CONTROL and the tail boom reads LDRC, in place of the manufacturer's name, which belongs to them. The shape is still modelled on a real machine; only the lettering has changed. Includes 0.9.694.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.694-tail-skid
versions.notes: The 3D helicopter's tail skid now rakes down and backwards with a black foot on the end, the way the real one does, so a tail-low landing would put the skid down rather than the tail blades. The landing skids have their black end caps, the tail rotor has two blades and its orange pitch bracket, and the tail stabiliser sits further aft. Includes 0.9.693.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.693-goblin-match
versions.notes: The 3D helicopter now matches the real Goblin in the details that show: wide flat black landing-gear plates instead of wire legs, the big dark cut-out low in the canopy side with its white surround, GOBLIN 770 and SAB HELI DIVISION lettering along the shell, pale flashes and orange chevrons near the blade tips, and pitch links on the rotor head. Includes 0.9.692.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.692-goblin-detail
versions.notes: The 3D helicopter is a proper model now. The nose bulge is gone - the whole shell is one smooth surface instead of spheres stuck together - and the front is shorter. The canopy stops behind the cabin, so you can see the black carbon frame, the motor, the servos and the battery, just as you can on the real thing. The boom carries GOBLIN lettering and a tail stabiliser, and the tail fin is swept rather than a square slab. Includes 0.9.691.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.691-goblin-livery
versions.notes: The 3D helicopter now looks like a real model helicopter: orange shell with the white and black graphics, white boom and skids, orange tail fin, and a blunt rounded nose instead of the sharp cone. It also has two blades, as a Goblin does, rather than four. Includes 0.9.690.
